model.name: 50% LASSO + 50% smoothed annual nowcast
model.interval: Conformal 80% band: empirical 10th/90th percentile of time-series out-of-fold residuals added to the point forecast. The Brazil band uses residuals of the summed state nowcasts.
model.interpretation: Same-week nowcast after Google Trends is observed; not a forecast of future weeks.

google_trends.normalization: Each UF is a separate three-term request normalized from 0 to 100. Values are not absolute counts and are not comparable across UFs.

srag.infogripe_filter: (TOSSE = 1 or GARGANTA = 1) and (DISPNEIA = 1 or SATURACAO = 1 or DESC_RESP = 1) and (HOSPITAL = 1 or EVOLUCAO in {2, 3})

infogripe.note: Current-view estimates are revised in place; dated weekly snapshots are archived separately before weights are learned.

lasso.note: Point metrics pool all rolling-origin horizons. Coverage is prequential: every interval uses only national residuals whose target week precedes that prediction's origin.
